core.note: Complete every required Computer Science course with a minimum 2.0 GPA.

electives.note: Select four elective Computer Science courses from the catalog list.

cognate.note: Complete the non-computing cognates, including one statistics choice, one math elective, and one lab science.

capstone.note: CIS 467 Computer Science Project is the major capstone. CIS 490 Internship is also required (2 to 5 credits).

title: Master of Science in Applied Computer Science
overview: The program consists of 11 three-credit courses (33 credit hours), consisting of core courses, an area of specialization (badge), electives, and a capstone option - an internship, project, or thesis. Classes are offered fully online, in a hybrid format, or in-person in the late afternoon or evening in downtown Grand Rapids.
Students must complete at least one badge (3 courses per badge):
Students must take enough elective credits to add up to the required 33 credits (9-12 credits).
